# Three.js pinned browser dependency

Version 0.180.0, MIT. Files downloaded from the jsDelivr npm distribution; license included as THREE-LICENSE.txt. `GLTFLoader.js` and `BufferGeometryUtils.js` import paths were rewritten to the local pinned modules. No other source changes were made to vendor code. No CDN access is required at runtime.

Official documentation: https://threejs.org/manual/pages/loading-3d-models.html

This version was selected for a reproducible prototype. Dependency/security review and update policy are required before production. All showroom/Pocket/building geometry is original demonstration content; the monogram source is the existing official project SVG.
